Throwback to the 90s: The Sand Art Craze! If you grew up in the 90s, you definitely remember sand art—those mesmerizing layers of neon and pastel sand in funky-shaped bottles! Whether you made one at a birthday party or picked one up at the mall, sand art was THE craft to have. It was all about choosing the perfect colors, layering them just right, and shaking it up when you got bored (we all did it). Now, sand art is making a comeback—but with a twist! At Elements and Ivy’s Succulent Bar, you can create your own grown-up version by layering colored sand in a glass container and adding a air plant on top! It’s the perfect mix of nostalgia and modern boho vibes. What color combo would you choose? Bright and bold like your 90s childhood? Or soft and dreamy pastels?
